Package com.commercetools.api.models.mcp_server

Interface McpServerUpdateAction

All Known Subinterfaces:
McpServerAddToolAction, McpServerAddToolCustomizationAction, McpServerRemoveToolAction, McpServerRemoveToolCustomizationAction, McpServerSetAuthenticationModeAction, McpServerSetDescriptionAction, McpServerSetJsonOutputFilteringAction, McpServerSetNameAction, McpServerSetStateAction, McpServerSetToolCustomizationsAction, McpServerSetToolOutputFormattingAction, McpServerSetToolsAction
public interface McpServerUpdateAction

Base type for MCP Server update actions. The action discriminator identifies the concrete update action to perform.

Example to create a subtype instance using the builder pattern 

     McpServerUpdateAction mcpServerUpdateAction = McpServerUpdateAction.addToolBuilder()
             tool(McpServerTool.ALL)
             .build()
